Class GraphDesk.Lanes

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.lcarsgraph.GraphDesk.Lanes
Enclosing class:
GraphDesk
private static final class GraphDesk.Lanes extends Object
One login keeps three serial seats. The model seat parses and asks. The vault seat reads and writes. The picture seat places. None of them is the event thread.
